<!--The title "Foster" for the fall 2023 film is just a rumor right now; please wait until a reliable source confirms it before adding it in.-->
[[File:Walt Disney Animation Studios Logo.svg|265px|right]]
[[Walt Disney Animation Studios]] is an American [[animation studio]] headquartered in [[Burbank, California]],<ref name="WDASOurStudio" /> the original feature film division of [[the Walt Disney Company]]. The studio's films are also often called "Disney Classics" (or "Classic Animated Features" in the case of the films with traditional hand drawn animation<ref>{{cite web |url=https://d23.com/a-to-z/animated-features-classic/ |title=Animated features, classic - D23 |website=d23.com |date=September 6, 2015 |access-date=March 29, 2023 |archive-date=March 29, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230329143756/https://d23.com/a-to-z/animated-features-classic/ |url-status=live}}</ref>), or "Disney Animated [[Canon (fiction)|Canon]]".<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rotoscopers.com/2020/03/13/so-you-want-to-review-the-disney-canon-some-tips/ |title=So You Want to Review the Disney Canon? Some Tips |author=Rachel Wagner |date=March 13, 2020 |website=Rotoscopers}}</ref>

Originally known as [[Walt Disney Productions]] (1937–1985), Walt Disney Animation (1986–1994) and Walt Disney Feature Animation (1994–2007), the studio has produced 64 films, beginning with ''[[Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (1937 film)|Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs]]'' in 1937, one of the first full-length animated feature films, and the first produced in the United States. The studio's most recent release is ''[[Zootopia 2]]'' in 2025, with their upcoming slate of films including ''[[Hexed (2026 film)|Hexed]]'' in 2026, ''[[Frozen 3]]'' in 2027,<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Disney Adds a Ton of 'Untitled Disney' Movies, Including One This Year |url=https://www.cnet.com/culture/entertainment/disney-adds-a-ton-of-untitled-disney-movies-including-one-this-year/ |access-date=2024-02-08 |website=CNET |language=en}}</ref> and ''Clay'' in 2028.<ref>{{Cite web |date=August 14, 2026 |title=Meet Clay and Mooshy from Disney's Clay, starring Kieran Culkin, in this new concept art and coming to theaters November 2028. #D23 |url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DcDCarGoFGT/ |access-date=August 14, 2026 |website=[[Instagram]]}}</ref> In addition, an unannounced film is scheduled to be released in 2029.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=D'Alessandro |first=Anthony |date=2026-03-20 |title=Disney Puts A Slew Of 2028 & 2029 Dates On Hold For Marvel, Pixar Pics & More |url=https://deadline.com/2026/03/disney-marvel-pixar-release-dates-1236761757/ |access-date=2026-03-22 |website=Deadline Hollywood |language=en-US}}</ref>

=== Unspecified projects ===
An unannounced film is scheduled to be released on June 15, 2029.<ref name=":1" />

=== In development ===
A fourth ''[[Frozen (franchise)|Frozen]]'' film is in development.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Rubin |first=Rebecca |date=November 16, 2023 |title=''Frozen 4'' in the Works at Disney, Bob Iger Reveals |url=https://variety.com/2023/film/news/frozen-4-confirmed-disney-bob-iger-1235792515/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231116193813/https://variety.com/2023/film/news/frozen-4-confirmed-disney-bob-iger-1235792515/ |archive-date=November 16, 2023 |access-date=November 16, 2023 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}}</ref> In November 2023, [[Jennifer Lee (filmmaker)|Jennifer Lee]] revealed that ten projects are in development, including films based upon original ideas.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/jennifer-lee-wish-disney-animation/|title= Jennifer Lee on ''Wish'', Leading Disney Animation and the Future of ''Frozen''|website=The Walt Disney Company|date=November 22, 2023|access-date=November 23, 2023}}</ref>

In July 2026, ahead of the release of the [[Moana (2026 film)|2026 live-action remake]] of ''[[Moana (2016 film)|Moana]]'' (2016), [[Dwayne Johnson]] confirmed that a third animated film in the ''[[Moana (franchise)|Moana]]'' franchise is in development.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Rubin |first=Rebecca |date=2026-07-02 |title='Moana 3' in the Works at Disney, According to Dwayne Johnson |url=https://variety.com/2026/film/news/moana-3-disney-1236235124/ |access-date=2026-07-02 |website=Variety |language=en-US}}</ref>

In August 2026, it was revealed that a third ''[[Zootopia (franchise)|Zootopia]]'' film is in development.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Moreau |first=Jordan |date=2026-08-14|title=  'Zootopia 3' in the Works at Disney |url=https://variety.com/2026/film/news/zootopia-3-disney-1236835053/ |access-date=2026-08-14 |website=Variety |language=en-US}}</ref>
